title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 199 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 199 - Application of Provisions for Collection of Information Without prejudice to the application of other provisions of this Act, the Income-tax authorities may apply the provisions contained in this Chapter. Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
